question: On DINOv2-B, does ArcFace or Proxy-Anchor give better Top-1 retrieval (Hit@1) than SupCon under one controlled protocol?
provenance_of_historical_table: DINOv2-SMALL (vit_small_patch14_dinov2), last 4 blocks, d_emb 256, lr_bb 3e-5, Protocol B LOCKED TEST (225 queries, 75 classes, gallery 809). ArcFace = 1 seed (s0, m=0.3, s=30); Proxy-Anchor and SupCon = mean of 3 seeds. Selection (loss choice, early stopping) used dev mAP. DINOv2-B was trained with SupCon only. The test set is consumed.
fixed_across_losses: official LVD-142M DINOv2-B init, last 4 blocks + final norm trainable, layer-wise lr decay 0.8, lr_bb 3e-5, lr_head 1e-3, d_emb 256, 224 px bicubic, flip-averaged L2-normalised embedding, 16 classes x 4 images class-balanced batches, 20 steps/epoch, max 60 epochs, patience 10, AdamW wd 1e-4, cosine lr, bf16, same augmentation ('base'), seeds 0/1/2, exact squared-L2 retrieval, relevance = same class label
protocol: train_B (772) for training; dev_query_B (150, 2/class) vs gallery_B (809) for ALL selection; Protocol B test (225) and C test (142) are CONSUMED -> reported as EXPLORATORY only, never used for any choice.

selection_rule.applies_to: epoch selection / early stopping inside a run and configuration selection across the hyper-parameter grid

final_stage: best configuration per loss (by the selection rule on seed-0 dev) is rerun with seeds 1 and 2; three matched seeds per loss.
reported: train GPU seconds, VRAM, embedding ms/image
historical_baseline: original mAP-selected SupCon (tau 0.1) checkpoints D5/D5ck seeds 0-2 are kept untouched and listed separately from the new Hit@1-selected checkpoints.
forbidden: No decision uses B-test/C-test numbers. No claim of a new independent test.
